definition: Do not use green_data_centers as an active top-level measure. A green or sustainable data center is an asset combined with one or more interventions rather than a distinct intervention itself. Energy-efficient cooling or equipment should be classified as energy_efficiency; renewable electricity as renewable_energy; emergency electricity as backup_power; hazard-informed location as climate_informed_siting; physical protection as resilient_infrastructure_design; and technical recovery arrangements as disaster_recovery. The asset taxonomy should identify the relevant facility, while the measure taxonomy identifies what the project actually does to improve its climate performance. A reference to a green, sustainable or climate-resilient data center should therefore not generate a measure unless the underlying intervention is identifiable.
note: Remove from the active measure classifier. Retain only as discovery language that should resolve to one or more underlying measures. v4 (2026-10-20): Dev's revision; measures are defined by the intervention, the asset map gives the asset.
